entities.summary: Maria Adeodata Pisani, OSB was a Maltese Benedictine nun at St Peter's Monastery in Mdina, Malta. Pope John Paul II beatified her on 9 May 2001. A number of bishops also released a pastoral letter stating that Pisani had a difficult childhood, renounced her wealth, and willingly lived as a cloistered nun.
